records.title: BNY and Ripple expand digital-asset custody and explore tokenized trade finance
records.summary: BNY states it now supports XRP and RLUSD on its Digital Asset Custody platform for eligible clients, builds on BNY's role as primary RLUSD reserve custodian and its custody relationship with Ripple Prime, and intends subject to final BNY/regulatory approvals to broaden XRPL tokenized-asset support and direct RLUSD mint/redeem. BNY and Ripple also intend to advance tokenized trade finance and are exploring a supply-chain-finance initiative with C2FO. BNY reports $63.4T assets under custody/administration and $2.2T AUM at 2026-09-30.
records.limitations: No XRP custody balance, client allocation, purchase, lending, collateral acceptance or actual XRPL trade-finance volume is disclosed. Future plans are expressly subject to final approvals.

records.title: C2FO and Ripple partner to modernize trade finance using the XRP Ledger
records.summary: The companies announced an initiative to bring financing and settlement activity for C2FO Instant Pay onto XRPL using RLUSD for settlement. Participating capital providers fund instant supplier payments. C2FO says its pre-existing Early Pay programs have helped businesses access more than $520B in working capital. The new Instant Pay solution has a waitlist.
records.limitations: The $520B is historical working-capital access through existing C2FO programs, not new XRPL volume or new capital deployed by this initiative. No Instant Pay loan volume, active suppliers, XRPL transaction count or XRP bridge use is disclosed.

records.title: Ripple and Coinbase partner to expand access to RLUSD
records.summary: RLUSD became available to retail and institutional clients through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase Retail app, with deposits/withdrawals on XRPL, Base and Ethereum. Ripple will provide RLUSD liquidity on Base. Coinbase Global Exchange availability and use of RLUSD as collateral were described as future availability, not live functionality.
records.limitations: Listing and supported transfer rails do not prove Coinbase bought XRP or that RLUSD is already accepted as collateral on Coinbase Global Exchange. The announcement does not quantify RLUSD balances, trading volume or XRP demand.

records.title: Ripple receives final OCC approval to establish a national trust bank
records.summary: Ripple states that Ripple National Trust Bank received final OCC approval. Approved activities include managing segregated RLUSD reserves, acting as collateral trustee for RLUSD reserves, and fiduciary digital-asset custody. Ripple states RLUSD will continue to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, its NYDFS-regulated limited-purpose trust company.
records.limitations: The release is Ripple's account of the regulatory action. Final approval/effectiveness does not by itself establish operational opening, client balances, actual reserve migration or a change in RLUSD's legal issuer.

records.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
records.title: Corporate Applications Search — Ripple National Trust Bank
records.summary: OCC CAS record 2025-Charter-342347 identifies Ripple National Trust Bank, proposed charter number 25364. It records approval on 2025-12-12 and consummated/effective status on 2026-10-26.
records.limitations: The CAS record establishes the charter action and effective date, not the bank's operational launch, customer deposits, XRP holdings or use of XRP as collateral.

records.title: Ripple reports approaching $900M annualized product revenue and multiple institutional partnerships
records.summary: Ripple says it is on track to exit 2026 at a $900M annualized product-revenue run rate, enabled $16T of transactions across its products in 2025, serves 1,700+ institutions/corporates/enterprises, operates in 60+ payout markets and is approaching $150B lifetime Ripple Payments volume by year-end. It also describes Ripple Treasury's 24/7 Returns product using RLUSD, tokenized money-market funds on XRPL and institutional liquidity infrastructure.
records.limitations: These are company-reported figures, not audited XRP-ledger volume, XRP trading volume, XRP collateral or token-holder cash flows. The $16T figure covers Ripple products broadly.

records.title: Ripple and Robinhood partner across RLUSD, treasury and prime brokerage
records.summary: Ripple and Robinhood announced RLUSD use across Robinhood's digital-asset ecosystem, RLUSD live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood, anticipated later Robinhood-app availability, RLUSD on XRPL for institutional settlement, Ripple Treasury integration and Ripple Prime financing/margin services for Bitstamp.
records.limitations: The announcement does not quantify settlement volume, XRP purchases, XRP collateral or the amount of actual capital committed. Some retail availability was described as future.

records.title: Coinbase Global, Inc. Form 10-Q for quarter ended 2026-09-30
records.summary: Coinbase reports Q3 2026 net revenue $1.2B, transaction revenue $590.2M, subscription/services revenue $570.2M, stablecoin revenue $306.905M versus $324.534M a year earlier (-5%), and USDC AOP of $8.616B at September 30. It says higher average USDC balances added $84.6M to Q3 stablecoin revenue while lower rates reduced it by $52.8M. Coinbase says it renewed its Circle arrangement on the same terms. Q3 product priorities include the everything exchange, stablecoins/payments and onchain adoption.
records.limitations: USDC AOP is a point-in-time Coinbase platform metric, not average balances or total USDC supply. Stablecoin revenue is not identical to Circle distribution payments. The filing does not disclose XRP-specific Coinbase collateral or balances in the unrecognized customer-collateral pool.

records.title: Circle Internet Group, Inc. Form 10-Q for quarter ended 2026-06-30
records.summary: Circle reports Q2 end-period USDC circulation $73.269B, average circulation $76.524B, USDC on Circle's own platform $12.442B and daily weighted-average on-platform share 19.5%. Circle reports Coinbase distribution costs of $324.6M in Q2 and $655.3M in H1 2026. The filing explains that Coinbase's allocation depends on USDC balances on its platform and broader ecosystem growth. Circle also describes Coinbase and Binance as strategic distribution partners.
records.limitations: Circle's $12.442B 'USDC on platform' is Circle's own platform measure, not Coinbase AOP. Distribution costs paid by Circle are not equivalent to Coinbase revenue or profit. This is Q2 data, not Q3.

records.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet, an economic operating system for the internet
records.summary: Circle announced Arc public mainnet with USDC as native gas currency, a permissioned validator cohort and institutional participants. SBI Group is a founding validator; Coinbase is listed among exchange-access partners, not validators. Aave and Morpho anchor Arc lending at launch; USYC, BUIDL and private-credit assets are described as collateral/liquidity assets.
records.limitations: Arc is a separate Circle network, not XRPL. Validator, exchange-access and lending-provider roles are distinct. The release includes forward-looking roadmap statements and does not prove XRP collateral or XRP liquidity on Arc.

records.title: SBI Holdings and Startale join Open Standard
records.summary: SBI Holdings and Startale announced participation in Open Standard. Coinbase is among the named participants in the broader consortium. The release describes exploring interoperability between JPYSC and OUSD.
records.limitations: Shared consortium participation is not proof of a direct SBI-Coinbase commercial contract, XRP integration, live JPYSC-OUSD transfer volume or a binding interoperability launch.

records.title: Ripple and SBI Group partner to launch RLUSD in Japan
records.summary: Ripple and SBI announced RLUSD availability in Japan through SBI VC Trade following JFSA approval. Ripple describes the 2016-started relationship and says SBI VC Trade was already the first company in Japan to handle USDC.
records.limitations: The announcement establishes product availability, not actual volumes, XRP bridge usage, collateral balances or exclusivity. SBI's simultaneous USDC, RLUSD, JPYSC and other network activity indicates a multi-rail strategy.

records.publisher: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (Tokyo SBIC)
records.title: Generative AI: the present and future — 2026-10-06 seminar
records.summary: The official page identifies the organizer as Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. and documents a 2026-10-06 generative-AI seminar discussing the rise of ChatGPT, with a Microsoft Japan executive evangelist as speaker.
records.limitations: This is an educational seminar. It does not establish an OpenAI partnership, ChatGPT investment, AI product ownership or any relationship to SBI Holdings. 'SBIC' here is not 'SBI'.

records.title: U.S. spot XRP ETF flows through 2026-10-29
records.summary: Dashboard covers five funds through the 2026-10-29 session and reports +$8.4M that day, +$98.9M over 30 sessions and $1.73B cumulative net inflow since its stated series start. It reports no issuer-published net assets or holdings for the covered funds.
records.limitations: Five-fund coverage and flow methodology differ from datasets covering six spot funds plus BITW. A reported ETF flow is not a complete measure of external capital, hedge exposure or all XRP demand.

records.title: Binance XRP USDT perpetual open interest and funding snapshot
records.summary: At 2026-10-30 22:45 UTC, the dashboard reports XRP price $1.25, Binance USDT perpetual open interest $330.9M, 24h OI change -11.2%, funding +0.0028% per period, 72% of accounts long and price change +0.4% over 24h.
records.limitations: This is one exchange's USDT perpetual contract, not aggregate XRP open interest. Account share is not notional exposure; dashboard sampling/latency and funding-period conventions must be retained.

records.title: Issuer-reported XRP ETF holdings and flows through 2026-10-29
records.summary: The dataset reports +6.40M XRP for 2026-10-29 across six spot funds plus BITW and total holdings of 1,196,650,118 XRP. It says daily flows are computed as day-over-day changes in issuer-reported holdings and excludes known capture gaps.
records.limitations: Coverage differs from Alpha Finance's five-fund series. Holdings deltas can include timing/capture effects and do not reveal hedges, beneficial owners or all external capital.

records.title: XRP ETF daily flows through 2026-10-29
records.summary: Maketo reports +$8.43M for 2026-10-29, +$4.8M over the past week and +$19M over the past month; it reports that two of five funds received inflows that day.
records.limitations: The underlying issuer universe and methodology must be reconciled with Alpha Finance and XRP Insights. It is not a separate source of beneficial-owner or hedge data.
